messages:
Maya (product): Heads-up — AcmeHealth just reiterated they need full per-request traces from the Console (error -> full trace link) for compliance reviews. Asking: ability to retrieve complete trace for a given error within 24h, retention 90d.
Samir (eng): Full-trace for every error is heavy. Need numbers: naive full-trace -> ~10x storage & indexing cost vs sampled traces. Can we do sampling + on-demand full retrieval?
Joni (sre): We currently sample ~10% by default. Real-world: enabling full traces for a customer increases trace write IOPS and storage. Proposal: keep sampling, capture KV for quick lookup, support backfill/fetch of full trace from raw ingest for flagged traces.
Maya (product): Customer expectation: UI flow where error card has "View full trace"; if not sampled, clicking triggers on-demand fetch/reconstruct and then shows spans. They require < 30s availability for fetched trace and audit that fetches are logged. @Samir can we meet that?
Samir (eng): Feasible but nontrivial. Two pieces: 1) infra: ability to reconstruct a raw trace from retained logs/segments; 2) API: fetch RPC + write-through cache to surface quickly on subsequent requests. Rough estimate: 2 sprints infra + 1 sprint API/console work. Need to validate retention windows and cold-read cost. :thinking_face:
Lee (design): UX notes: show a spinner + "fetching full trace" state and incremental spans as they arrive. Also show provenance/timestamp and a prominent audit tag. We should avoid blocking error list rendering.
Maya (product): Suggested launch criteria we should vet: 1) Feature gated per-customer (opt-in). 2) End-to-end fetch success >= 95% within 30s for sampled-unseen traces. 3) Per-customer cost delta < 15% for typical workloads (measure in canary). 4) Audit log entries for every fetch.
Joni (sre): Ops checklist: rate-limit fetches (burst cap), background backfill throttling, eviction policy for fetch-cache. Also need alert if fetch-cost spikes > 2x baseline.
Samir (eng): Action items: I'll draft RFC with perf/back-of-envelope cost model + API contract and spike plan for reconstructing traces from segments. If product OK, eng will prioritize a canary on Dedicated for a single customer (AcmeHealth) to measure real econ.
Maya (product): Thanks — please drop RFC link here when ready. I'll sync with account team and confirm opt-in gating and compliance logging.
